verdict.rationale: Open WebUI connects to multiple providers and lets users switch models mid-conversation by hand. Nothing in the evidence documents automatic fallback to another provider or model when one errors or rate-limits. Python Functions/Pipes that can add custom models are only developer building blocks someone could use to build failover, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, model failover keeps the assistant working — automatic fallback to another provider or model when one errors or rate-limits
